package.name: omni_console
package.description: omni-robot: the operator console's robot side. mission_node (the missions over mode_manager and Nav2: Manual, Go To, Explore, Patrol, Catch, Thrower, Follow / Tag, Program, Calibrate; settings, places, zones, the throw log, health, session logs, one status topic), supervisor (serves web/, the page, and starts and stops the robot's software: the console is the launcher), console_web (serves the page alone). The page reaches the robot through rosbridge. Runs on the Jetson; no sim in it.
